name: function-hooks
description: Refuses, rewrites, and queues tool calls by policy, draws edit diagnostics, captures, notices, and down services, runs writers at stop, and with observation on records hook events and delivers findings

observation.title: Observation
observation.description: Recording of hook events and refused calls as database rows, agent spawns and finding delivery at stop boundaries

walkPolicy.title: Walk policy
walkPolicy.description: Refusal of a Bash walker that descends into ~/Library/CloudStorage

editThreshold.title: Edit threshold
editThreshold.description: Unjudged in-tree files edited on a lineage that spawn the edit agent at a quiet boundary, 0 off

editAgent.title: Edit agent
editAgent.description: Agent under .claude/agents/ that judges the unjudged edits of one lineage's range

categoryThreshold.title: Category threshold
categoryThreshold.description: Confirmed sites a recurring category needs to spawn the category agent at a quiet boundary, 0 off

categoryAgent.title: Category agent
categoryAgent.description: Agent under .claude/agents/ that builds a checker rule for one recurring category
